comparison_to_prior_snapshot.state: Price UP/HOLD + CVD UP + OI DOWN

interpretation: Price is holding above dOpen and dPOC while CVD improves and OI contracts slightly. This is constructive because aggressive buy flow is improving without a fresh leverage build. It can represent spot-led demand and/or short covering. It is healthier than Price UP + CVD UP + OI UP crowding, but it is not a reason to chase because the next major reference resistance is dVAH around 78.375k.

management.warning: If price loses dPOC/dOpen while CVD rolls over and OI starts rising, regime flips toward bearish leverage expansion.
management.limit_order_note: Keep previously planned execution-venue limits only if current basis remains compatible; do not move them upward just because CVD improved. Recalculate reference-to-execution basis before changing orders.

lesson: Price holding above reclaimed value with CVD rising and OI falling is a high-quality continuation state because demand/covering is lifting price while leverage is being cleaned. Signal quality is better than a leveraged chase, but structural resistance still matters.
